\begin{lstlisting}[language={},basicstyle=\ttfamily\scriptsize,breaklines=true]
# Generated by LeanFM from protocol SignIn: the requests App serves. Regenerate it rather than editing.
components:
  schemas:
    Callback:
      additionalProperties: false
      description: "The browser follows the redirect to the app's callback with the code."
      properties:
        code:
          type: "string"
        state:
          type: "string"
      required:
        - "state"
        - "code"
      title: "Callback"
      type: "object"
    ErrorCallback:
      additionalProperties: false
      description: "Or it follows the error redirect to the same callback route."
      properties:
        error:
          type: "string"
        state:
          type: "string"
      required:
        - "state"
        - "error"
      title: "ErrorCallback"
      type: "object"
    RedirectToIdp:
      additionalProperties: false
      description: "The app sends the browser to the identity provider. state is the session's key: it comes back on the callback and is how the app tells concurrent sign-ins apart. code_challenge is PKCE's S256 hash of a verifier only the app knows."
      properties:
        client_id:
          type: "string"
        code_challenge:
          type: "string"
        redirect_uri:
          type: "string"
        state:
          type: "string"
      required:
        - "state"
        - "client_id"
        - "redirect_uri"
        - "code_challenge"
      title: "RedirectToIdp"
      type: "object"
    SignInFailed:
      additionalProperties: false
      properties: {}
      required: []
      title: "SignInFailed"
      type: "object"
    SignedIn:
      additionalProperties: false
      description: "Signed in: the app sends the browser on to where it started."
      properties:
        return_to:
          type: "string"
      required:
        - "return_to"
      title: "SignedIn"
      type: "object"
    Start:
      additionalProperties: false
      description: "The browser asks the app to sign in; return_to is where to go afterwards."
      properties:
        return_to:
          type: "string"
      required:
        - "return_to"
      title: "Start"
      type: "object"
info:
  description: "The requests App receives in protocol SignIn, generated by LeanFM from the session type."
  title: "SignIn: App"
  version: "0.1.0"
openapi: "3.1.0"
paths:
  "/callback":
    get:
      operationId: "CallbackErrorCallback"
      parameters:
        - in: "query"
          name: "state"
          required: true
          schema:
            type: "string"
        - in: "query"
          name: "code"
          required: false
          schema:
            type: "string"
        - in: "query"
          name: "error"
          required: false
          schema:
            type: "string"
      responses:
        "302":
          description: "SignedIn: the Location URL carries return_to as query parameters"
          headers:
            Location:
              required: true
              schema:
                format: "uri"
                type: "string"
        "401":
          content:
            "application/json":
              schema:
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/SignInFailed"
          description: "SignInFailed"
      summary: "Callback or ErrorCallback from Browser"
  "/login":
    get:
      operationId: "Start"
      parameters:
        - in: "query"
          name: "return_to"
          required: true
          schema:
            type: "string"
      responses:
        "302":
          description: "RedirectToIdp: the Location URL carries state, client_id, redirect_uri, code_challenge as query parameters"
          headers:
            Location:
              required: true
              schema:
                format: "uri"
                type: "string"
      summary: "Start from Browser"
\end{lstlisting}
